author: anon-df5e95db
content: Unlocked by CL-6 + CL-26. 60-line C function: translates a BCF record from one header's ID space to another's. Calls bcf_unpack then remaps all tag IDs (INFO keys, FORMAT keys, filter IDs, contig ID) using bcf_hdr_id2int on the target header. Our HeaderView caches make the lookups O(1).
